records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近因為被指控在 iPhone 上以未實現的「Enhanced Siri」功能誤導消費者，已達成最高 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）** 的和解協議【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這項和解金額上限為 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）**，若法院批准，將可能成為 Apple 歷史上規模最大的和解之一，但來源僅說「could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解涉及的訴訟指稱 Apple 在行銷「Enhanced Siri features」時，實際功能尚未推出，導致消費者基於錯誤廣告購買 iPhone【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解適用的機型包括 **iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 以及 iPhone 15 Pro Max**，購買期間為 **2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 約 **0.37 億（37 million）** 部符合條件的 iPhone 用戶可提出索賠【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 每部符合條件的設備初始可獲 **$25**，最終金額視索賠情況而定，最高不超過 **$95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示已解決此事，以便專注於「提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布全新 AI 驅動的 Siri（稱為 **Siri AI**），將於今年秋季以 beta 形式先在美國英語市場推出，並結合 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型與自家 Apple Intelligence 平台【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- Siri AI 能夠從使用者的應用程式中提取上下文，讓使用者只需說出需求（例如要聽妹妹推薦的播客）即可直接呈現內容，而不必另開 App【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為了提供這項智慧，Apple 簽署協議使用 Google 的 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 以及 Gemini Image 模型，並利用 Google Search 進行知識基礎的 grounding；但 Apple 明確表示不使用 Google 向客戶部署的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 新增的 **Siri App** 讓對話與個人化資訊更集中，同時強調安全與隱私，並將這些 AI 功能嵌入 Safari、Password 與 Messages 等核心應用【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 影片與文字說明指出，Beta 版將於今年秋季在美國以英語先行推出，屆時使用者仍處於測試階段，需先行調整期待【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 分析師認為，除了 Siri 的升級，Apple 近期 iPhone 銷售在過去四季已成長 **16%**，顯示產品升級與 AI 整合對營收有正面帶動【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Apple 透過與 Google 合作的 Gemini 模型、內建 Apple Intelligence，推出更具上下文感知與隱私保護的 Siri AI，並計畫在今年秋季以 beta 方式先行在美國英語市場測試。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了多項大型合作協議，包含 5 GW 的 AI 基礎建設戰略夥伴關係、價值 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） 的五年 AI Cloud 合約，以及最高可達 21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 的投資認購權，這些安排將隨著 NVIDIA GPU 部署而逐步生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

- IREN 在 2026 年第三季宣布，與 NVIDIA 建立 5 GW 的 AI 基礎建設合作，雙方將共同部署 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施，並以此支撐 AI Cloud 服務的快速擴張【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

$IREN
$NVDA
2 hours ago
By: CryptoProwl
IREN Limited (NASDAQ:
$IREN
) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvidia (NASDAQ:
$NVDA
) partnership that gives its AI infrastructure pivot a much larger public-market signal. The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

- **服務業務與定價能力**：服務部門持續以雙位數增長，且 Apple 已展現提升服務價格的能力，顯示其在生態系統內具備定價權【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **生態系統與用戶黏著**：公司擁有龐大的裝置安裝基數（超過 25 億部設備），生態系統鎖定效應使得用戶升級與服務消費具備長期可持續性，未來 Apple Intelligence 功能的擴散將進一步提升升級頻率與經常性收入【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **持續的資本回報**：Apple 透過穩定的股息發放與大規模的股票回購（如 FY2026 上半年已回購 **370 億美元（$37.0 billion）**），提供投資人明確的回報底線【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。

- **風險與競爭優勢的平衡**：儘管面臨監管挑戰（如 DOJ 訴訟與 EU DMA），Apple 仍憑藉其高毛利服務、強大現金流與資本配置能力，能在潛在衝擊下維持財務穩健，這也是投資者視其為「核心」長期持有標的的原因【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

綜合以上因素——卓越的現金產生能力、極高的利潤率、持續增長的高毛利服務、強大的生態系統鎖定與穩定的股東回報——Apple 被認為是一支適合長期持有的優質股票。

1. **AI 功能提升使用者黏著度**：Apple 在 WWDC 上推出的 Siri AI 以 Google Gemini 模型為基礎，能在應用程式間取得上下文，讓使用者在不切換 App 的情況下完成查詢與操作，提升數位助理的實用性【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

Apple 近期的營收成長已達兩位數，且透過 WWDC 推出的 Siri AI 以及相關 AI 生態系統（Apple Intelligence、Safari、訊息與密碼管理等）提升服務與硬體的互補性，預計將為公司在服務收入與高階 iPhone 銷售上提供持續的成長動能。這些因素共同支持 Apple 在未來一年內保持營收正向增長的潛力。

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion. Definition and Limitations of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting 

A company's internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. A company's internal control over financial reporting includes those policies and procedures that (1) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (2) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance with authorizations of management and directors of the company; and (3) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the company's assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements. Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not prevent or detect misstatements.

- **CUDA 軟體平台**：2006 年推出的 CUDA 讓所有 NVIDIA GPU 具備通用平行運算能力，成為開發者部署深度學習與高效能運算的基礎，全球已有超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。  
- **全堆疊 AI 數據中心**：公司提供涵蓋 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU（Data Processing Unit）的完整硬體組合，並以 Blackwell 架構實現資料中心規模的 AI 訓練與推論，透過極致的晶片、網路、系統與軟體共同設計，提升效能與規模【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #19】。  
- **軟體生態與 AI 服務**：NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等套件，提供模型微調、強化學習與安全部署的完整解決方案，讓企業能在 NVIDIA 加速的基礎設施上快速建置生成式與代理式 AI 應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。  
- **開發者與合作夥伴網路**：公司透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute 以及與全球主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務供應商的合作，建立龐大的生態系統，進一步鞏固平台的市場黏著度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。  
- **多元產業應用與統一架構**：GPU 的平行處理能力（數萬個運算核心）支撐生成式 AI、代理式 AI、醫療、汽車、電信等多個數十億美元的終端市場，統一的可程式化架構讓同一平台能服務多樣化產業，提升平台價值與客戶依賴度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。  
- **高效能互連與規模化**：透過 2020 年收購 Mellanox，NVIDIA 擁有先進的資料中心互連技術，使數十萬顆 GPU 能夠互相連接成單一巨型計算機，進一步加強其資料中心規模優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  

以上各項硬體創新、軟體堆疊、廣大開發者社群與端到端平台整合，構成了 NVIDIA 在加速計算與 AI 市場的核心技術護城河。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 產品組合，作為 AI 驅動的生產力工具，並以此提升雲端服務收入與每位使用者的價值。  

- Microsoft 365 Commercial 被定位為「AI‑powered」平台，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在同一生態系，透過加入 AI 功能、特點與代理情境（agentic scenarios）來擴展通信、協作、分析、安全與合規等商務生產力領域【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。

- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的擴大，成本項目（cost of revenue）增加了 6.8 億美元，反映了 AI 基礎設施的投資【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 同期毛利因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的增長（包括 Copilot）提升 44 億美元，毛利率亦因雲端效率改善而略有上升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 在消費者端，Microsoft 365 Consumer 雲端收入亦因 Copilot 相關的每位使用者收入提升與 7% 的訂閱者增長而上升 33%，顯示 Copilot 的功能正向滲透至消費者產品【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  

綜合以上，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 融入 Microsoft 365 的核心套件與雲端服務，並在產品路線圖中以 AI 功能擴充各類商務與消費者場景，達成收入與毛利的同步成長。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在透過持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施投資與對 Anthropic 的股權與融資安排，來加速其人工智慧與機器學習服務的佈局【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #206】。

- **整體策略**：Amazon 明確表示未來會「增加科技與基礎設施支出」，以支援 AI 與機器學習計畫，並將此類支出視為長期成長的關鍵【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #206】。  
- **支出規模**：在 2026 年第二季（Q2 2026）以及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六個月內，科技與基礎設施成本較去年同期上升 4.27 億美元（$427 million），主要來自基礎設施（包括折舊與攤銷）的投入【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #80】。公司亦說明「預期科技與基礎設施支出將持續增加」以因應 AI/ML 需求【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #80】。  
- **成本分配**：這些成本會依使用量分配至各事業部門，確保 AWS 相關服務得到足夠資源【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #80】。  
- **Anthropic 合作**：Amazon 已於 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026）投入 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 購買 Anthropic 的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。此外，Amazon 與 Anthropic 簽訂了一項融資安排，提供最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的授信額度，於達成特定運算容量里程碑時可轉為 Anthropic 可轉換債或 IPO 後的普通股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。Amazon 亦保留 **最高 50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 的選擇權，可在未來的股權融資中進一步投資 Anthropic，若行使此選項，將減少上述授信額度【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  
- **目的與預期**：上述股權與授信安排旨在確保 Amazon 能取得 Anthropic 的 AI 計算能力與技術，並透過 AWS 雲端服務與自家晶片（AWS chips）共同提供給客戶，進一步強化其在生成式 AI 市場的競爭力【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 的投資策略是：**持續加碼 AWS 基礎設施與相關硬體、提升 AI/ML 研發支出，同時透過股權與授信方式深度參與 Anthropic 的發展，以確保在雲端 AI 服務上的領先地位**。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商平台面臨多項反壟斷與監管風險，主要包括競爭法、消費者保護法、資料隱私法以及稅務合規等方面的調查與訴訟。  

- **競爭與反壟斷調查**：美國、加拿大、英國等地的州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會已對 Amazon 的店舖運營、履行網路、Prime 服務以及 AWS 的雲端服務提出「價格固定、濫用支配地位、壟斷或企圖壟斷」等指控，並要求賠償數十億美元的損害、懲罰性賠償與結構性救濟等。相關訴訟已在美國華盛頓西區聯邦法院（Frame‑Wilson v. Amazon.com, Inc.）等多個司法管轄區提出，且部分指控已在美國獲得部分駁回，但仍有部分指控存續。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #46]  

- **AWS 相關專利與技術指控**：2025 年 6 月，Xockets, Inc. 在德克薩斯州西區聯邦法院對 Amazon.com, Inc. 與 Amazon Web Services, Inc. 提起訴訟，指稱 AWS Nitro 系統的若干版本侵犯多項美國專利，屬於技術與知識產權層面的法律風險。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #46]  

- **資料隱私與數據治理**：Amazon 正在面對一系列關於資料收集、使用與披露的「新興且碎片化」的法律與規範調查，這些規範仍在演變中，可能導致合規成本上升與營運限制。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #160]、[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #129]  

- **稅務挑戰**：在意大利，Amazon 正遭受稅務相關的調查與挑戰，屬於地區性稅務合規風險的一環。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #128]、[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #130]  

- **潛在的財務與營運衝擊**：上述不利的監管決策、法律訴訟或執行行動可能導致「巨額罰款、民事與刑事責任、合規成本上升、需求下降、營運中斷、管理層資源分散與聲譽受損」等實質影響，進而阻礙 Amazon 的成長與業務運作。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #160]、[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #129]  

總結而言，Amazon 在其核心的電商平台、Prime 會員服務以及 AWS 雲端業務上，同時面臨來自多國監管機構的反壟斷、資料隱私與稅務等多層面的監管風險，且公司已表明將「堅決抗辯」這些指控。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode** 把 Gemini 大型語言模型直接嵌入搜尋體驗，讓使用者可以以更自然的語句提問，並利用 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力得到更完整的答案；同時在 Google Workspace（Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Drive、Meet 等）推出 **Gemini for Google Workspace**，提供 AI 代理人協助撰寫、組織、視覺化與加速工作流程；在 Google Cloud 方面則以 **Gemini Enterprise** 形式提供企業級 AI 代理人與基礎設施，讓企業客戶在雲端平台上部署自動化與智慧化的工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #141】【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #44】。  

- **搜尋整合**：AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 皆以 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態功能提升搜尋結果的品質與深度，使用者可在單一查詢中獲得更具洞見的回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  
- **Workspace 整合**：Gemini for Google Workspace 把 AI 代理人帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者撰寫內容、整理資訊、製作圖表，並提升會議與協作的生產力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #141】。  
- **Cloud 整合**：Gemini Enterprise 作為 Google Cloud Platform 的 AI 服務之一，提供企業客戶可消費的 AI 基礎設施與平台（包括 Vertex AI），支援企業在雲端環境中建置自動化與智慧化解決方案【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #44】。  
- **產品覆蓋**：公司聲稱其 15 個半億用戶的產品（其中七個擁有 20 億用戶）皆已使用 Gemini 模型，顯示 Gemini 已深度滲透至搜尋、Workspace 與 Cloud 等核心產品生態系【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。  

透過上述三大渠道的整合，Google 讓 Gemini AI 成為搜尋、協作工具與企業雲端服務的共同底層技術，從使用者端到企業端皆能即時存取與運用 AI 功能。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google Search 已從只顯示十個藍色連結的簡單列表，演變成以大型語言模型為核心的動態、多模態體驗，並推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來直接回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  

- AI Overviews 讓使用者只要輸入任何問題，就能即時得到有幫助的回覆，提升搜尋的即時性與完整性【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- AI Mode 則利用 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力，讓使用者能提出更細緻、需要多步推理的問題，原本可能需要多次搜尋才能得到的答案，現在可以一次完成【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 這些功能是 Alphabet 在 2025 年將 AI 深度整合到產品與服務中的一環，先以提升使用者體驗為主，再考慮後續的變現方式，同時因應其他開發者與 AI 服務供應商的激烈競爭【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  
- 為了支撐 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 所需的大量運算，Alphabet 正加大對伺服器、網路設備與資料中心的資本支出，並持續在資料中心效率上投入研發，以確保 AI 服務的可擴展性與成本效益【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  

總結來說，Google Search 透過引入 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，將搜尋從單純的關鍵字匹配升級為能理解自然語言、提供即時、深度回應的 AI 驅動平台，以保持在生成式 AI 時代的競爭力與使用者黏著度。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是透過 AI、穿戴裝置與硬體創新，打造下一代介面與沉浸式的元宇宙生態系，並持續投入長期研發與產品化工作【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #170】。

- META 認為元宇宙是「具身的網路」(embodied internet)，未來將超越二維螢幕，提供沉浸式體驗，因而在 2021 年將策略調整為聚焦於將元宇宙實現的相關技術與產品【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #170】。  
- 為此，META 將資源導向 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置介面等領域，致力於開發「下一代介面」(next‑generation interfaces)【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #170】。  
- 在 Reality Labs，許多投資聚焦於「長期、前沿的研發」(long‑term, cutting edge research and development)，目標是開發目前尚未上市、可能在未來十年才完整實現的產品【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #116】。  
- 近期的產品開發包括 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置、Meta Horizon Store 內容、以及具穿透功能的 VR 體驗，這些都是為了提升 VR 的採用率與接受度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
- 在穿戴裝置方面，META 正在開發 AI 眼鏡與 AR 方案，已推出 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta 眼鏡，並於 2024 年展示 Orion 原型 AR 眼鏡，2025 年推出結合 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建顯示的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，並配合使用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
- 這些短期與長期專案均屬於 Reality Labs 的雙軌策略：一方面推出可立即上市的產品與服務，另一方面持續進行更遠期的研發，以期在未來十年內實現更完整的 AR/VR 生態系【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  

總結來說，META 的長期投資方向是以 AI、AR/VR 硬體與軟體結合的方式，持續研發未來十年才可能成熟的元宇宙相關技術，同時透過現有的 VR 及 AI 眼鏡產品加速使用者採用，為「下一代介面」奠定基礎【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #170】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #116】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 透過廣告收入的「每則廣告平均價格」模式獲利，同時以 Meta AI 作為跨平台的智慧助理，提供使用者在所有 Meta 應用程式以及 AI 眼鏡與網路服務中的搜尋、創作與互動功能【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #210】。  

- **廣告獲利模式**：Meta 先計算總廣告收入，然後除以實際投放的廣告數量，得到每則廣告的平均價格，這個價格即為行銷商為每則廣告（不論是曝光或行動目標）所支付的金額【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #210】。  
- **廣告投放與調整**：投放的廣告數量會因產品而異（例如影片與 Reels 的變現率尚未與 Feed 或 Stories 同步），且 Meta 會不定期調整廣告的數量或頻率，以配合產品與變現策略【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #210】。  
- **收入認列**：對於非主要代理的廣告收入安排，Meta 以淨額方式認列收入【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #210】。  
- **近期表現**：2026 年第一季廣告曝光量較 2025 年同期成長 19%，平均每則廣告的價格亦上升 12%，使得廣告收入成為營收成長的主要驅動力【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #188】。  

- **Meta AI 的角色**：Meta AI 是一個跨所有 Meta 應用程式（Family of Apps）可使用的智慧助理，同時也提供獨立的應用、AI 眼鏡與網路平台。它的功能包括協助使用者學習、完成任務、產出內容以及與他人連結，從而提升各 App 的使用體驗與互動深度【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **應用範圍**：Meta AI 在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等應用程式中皆可被呼叫，並延伸至 Meta AI 眼鏡等硬體裝置，形成「AI 助手」的全方位服務生態系【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #113】、【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，Meta 以每則廣告的平均價格為核心的廣告變現模式，結合靈活的廣告投放與頻率調整，並藉由 Meta AI 在所有應用程式與硬體上的助理功能，提升使用者黏著度與平台價值。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛技術（FSD/Autopilot）作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是因為每一台交付的車輛都被設計成具備自動駕駛能力，並透過人工智慧持續以 OTA 軟體更新提升安全與便利功能，讓其在功能與使用者體驗上與其他車廠形成明顯區隔【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。

- **全車系皆具備自動駕駛基礎**：Tesla 表示「Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy」，意味著自動駕駛是所有車型的內建前提，而非少數高階車型的選配【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  
- **AI 與軟體持續升級**：公司透過「over-the-air software updates」不斷改進這些功能，類似航空業在允許條件下使用的自動化系統，提升駕駛者在路上可被「relieve」的繁瑣與危險任務【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  
- **將 AI 功能商品化**：在產品線中加入「FSD (Supervised)」與其他 AI 軟體功能，作為提升車輛性能與功能的關鍵賣點，並以此「generate demand」及「competitively price」車輛【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #153】。  
- **Robotaxi 服務作為新商業模式**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務，利用同樣的自動駕駛技術提供無人駕駛叫車平台，為公司開啟「service‑driven business model」的成長潛力，進一步鞏固其技術領先地位【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34】。  
- **技術差異化的戰略定位**：Tesla 強調其 AI 能力與自動駕駛技術「differentiate us from our competitors」，並認為這些創新將在未來的增長與利潤中扮演關鍵角色【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  

綜合上述，Tesla 透過全車系自動駕駛設計、持續的 AI 軟體升級、將 FSD 內嵌於車輛功能與價格策略，以及以 Robotaxi 服務開創新營收來源，將自動駕駛技術打造為與其他汽車製造商最顯著的差異化核心。

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「高度且日益加劇」的競爭環境，來自既有大型車廠、新興電動車廠商以及其他進入自動駕駛與能源領域的公司，這些競爭者可能導致 Tesla 的車輛銷量、價格與營收受到壓力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #79】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。

- **多元競爭者**：全球越來越多既有車廠與新進公司已進入或計畫進入電動車（EV）以及混合動力、插電式混合動力與全電動車市場，與 Tesla 同時爭奪同一細分市場（如 Cybertruck 與其他皮卡、Model 3/Model Y 與緊湊 SUV 等）【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #79】。  
- **自動駕駛與軟體平台**：除了車輛本身，許多公司也在開發自動駕駛技術與相關服務，形成額外的競爭層面【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。  
- **資源與成本優勢**：部分競爭者擁有「顯著更多或更成熟的資源」以及因地理位置或經濟環境取得的成本效率，可能在設計、製造、分銷、推廣與售後支援上取得優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。  
- **政府與經濟激勵**：某些政府與經濟激勵措施偏向在本土組裝或使用本地供應商的製造商，這可能使競爭對手受惠，進一步削弱 Tesla 的獲利能力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。  
- **可能的負面影響**：上述競爭因素可能導致「車輛單位銷售下降、價格下調、營收缺口、失去客戶與市場佔有率」等不利結果，進而影響 Tesla 的業務、財務狀況與營運成果【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。  
- **能源與儲能領域的競爭**：在能源發電與儲能業務方面，Tesla 亦面臨其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與大型公用事業公司的競爭，且電價下降可能使其產品吸引力降低【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。  
- **機器人（Bots）業務的競爭**：Tesla 正在開發包括 Optimus 在內的機器人產品，該領域仍屬新興產業，且有眾多公司在設計、開發與建造機器人方面競爭，若開發進度不如預期，亦可能對整體業務產生負面影響【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100】。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為與汽車事業平行的第二個主要營運分部，透過提供住宅、商業與工業客戶以及公用事業的太陽能與儲能解決方案，推動清潔能源的採用，同時利用其深厚的電機、機械、土木與軟體工程能力，補強整體成長基礎【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- 這項業務與汽車事業共同構成 Tesla 的兩大營運分部：汽車與能源生成與儲能【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 在能源生成與儲能分部，Tesla 透過網站、實體店面、畫廊以及渠道合作夥伴，向住宅、商業、工業客戶與公用事業行銷與銷售太陽能與儲能產品，並在部分商業客戶採用電力購買協議（PPA）模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #54】。  
- 公司強調「簡化、標準化與可及性」的策略，以降低客戶採用清潔能源的成本與取得成本【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #54】。  
- Tesla 依賴其在電氣、機械、土木與軟體工程方面的專業，設計、製造與安裝能源產生與儲存產品，從住宅規模到公用事業規模皆能提供客製化解決方案；例如 Megapack 產品的整合設計可大幅減少現場組裝工作量【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #48】。  

因此，能源生成與儲能業務在 Tesla 的整體策略中，扮演著擴大營收來源、加速清潔能源佈局、並以其工程與製造優勢支援公司長期成長的關鍵角色。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，它在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板電腦及穿戴裝置市場僅佔少數市場份額，且面臨資源充足、價格激進的激烈競爭壓力。  

- Apple 表示自己在智慧型手機、PC、平板與穿戴裝置的全球市場僅擁有「少數」市佔（minority market share）【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】；同樣的說法亦出現在競爭章節中【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- 10‑K 進一步說明，競爭者擁有「廣泛的產品線、低價產品、大量活躍裝置的已安裝基礎以及龐大的客戶基礎」，且「積極降價、降低產品毛利」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
- 某些競爭者甚至具備「資源、經驗或成本結構」使其能「以極低或無利潤，甚至虧損的價格」提供產品與服務【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】；此情形在競爭章節亦被重申【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- 由於上述激烈的價格與產品競爭，若 Apple 無法成功競爭，將可能對其業務、聲譽、營運結果、財務狀況與股價產生「重大不利影響」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過提供高收益潛力、與自家硬體與服務深度整合的生態系統，以及 App Store 的分潤機制，來提升第三方開發者的黏著度；然而，由於 iPhone、Mac、iPad 與穿戴裝置在全球市場的佔有率相對較低，開發者仍可能較傾向於 Android（手機與平板）與 Windows（個人電腦）等平台【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。

- Apple 明確指出，開發者是否願意持續為其平台開發與維護軟體，取決於在「與 Android、Windows 等競爭平台相比」的感知利益，包括預期可產生的收入、產品銷售的未來成長以及開發成本等因素【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。  
- 同時，Apple 也承認其在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的「少數市場佔有率」會使開發者較不願投入資源於 Apple 平台，反而更傾向於市場佔有率較大的 Android 與 Windows 平台【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。  
- 為了維持開發者的參與，Apple 透過 App Store 取得應用程式與數位內容的銷售佣金；若開發者改用直接對消費者的分銷模式，Apple 可能失去這部分收入，進一步影響其營收與開發者的動機【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #36】。  
- Apple 亦指出，若第三方開發者無法或選擇不跟上快速的技術變化，可能導致其應用程式無法利用新功能，進而降低使用者體驗，削弱對 Apple 產品的需求，這也是 Apple 必須持續提供技術支援與工具以維持開發者黏著度的原因【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #125】。  

綜合以上，Apple 的開發者黏著度主要建構於：  
1. **收益與市場機會**：透過 App Store 分潤與龐大付費用戶基礎提供較高的收入潛力。  
2. **生態系統整合**：硬體、作業系統與服務的緊密結合，使開發者的產品能在多設備間無縫運作。  
3. **技術支援與工具**：持續更新的開發工具與平台，減少開發者因技術落後而流失的風險。  
4. **市場佔有率挑戰**：相較於 Android 與 Windows 的較大市場份額，Apple 必須透過上述優勢來彌補其較低的裝置基數，才能維持開發者的忠誠度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #125】。

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新的三個月（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）營收下降了 1.79 億美元（$179 million），跌幅約 1%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #119】。  

- **抵銷因素**：  
  - **Windows 與 Devices** 營收下降 1.03 億美元（$103 million），跌幅 2%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #119】。  
  - **Gaming** 營收下降 3.8 億美元（$380 million），跌幅 7%，其中 Xbox 硬體與內容服務均受衝擊【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #119】。  
  - **Search advertising** 營收則增加 3.04 億美元（$304 million），增幅 9%，抵消了部分硬體與遊戲收入的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #119】。  

因此，More Personal Computing 的總體營收因硬體與遊戲收入的下降被搜尋廣告收入的增長部分抵消。

[AMZN 10-Q period 202606] [section: Foreign Exchange Risk] Foreign Exchange Risk

During Q2 2026, net sales from our International segment accounted for 21% of our consolidated revenues. Net sales and related expenses generated from our internationally-focused stores, including within Canada and Mexico (which are included in our North America segment), are primarily denominated in the functional currencies of the corresponding stores and primarily include Euros, British Pounds, and Japanese Yen. The results of operations of, and certain of our intercompany balances associated with, our internationally-focused stores and AWS are exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations. Upon consolidation, as foreign exchange rates vary, net sales and other operating results may differ materially from expectations, and we may record significant gains or losses on the remeasurement of intercompany balances. For example, as a result of fluctuations in foreign exchange rates throughout the period compared to rates in effect the prior year, International segment net sales in Q2 2026 decreased by $82 million in comparison with Q2 2025. We have foreign exchange risk related to foreign-denominated cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities (“foreign funds”). Based on the balance of foreign funds as of June 30, 2026, of $20.4 billion, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in declines of $1.0 billion, $2.0 billion, and $4.1 billion. We also have foreign exchange risk related to our intercompany balances denominated in various currencies. Based on the intercompany balances as of June 30, 2026, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in losses of $400 million, $795 million, and $1.6 billion, recorded to “Other income (expense), net.”

Our foreign currency-denominated unsecured senior notes create exposure to changes in foreign exchange rates. As of June 30, 2026, we have designated $20.7 billion of our Euro- and Canadian Dollar-denominated Notes as net investment hedges to mitigate foreign currency exposures related to the translation of our investments in foreign operations to U.S. dollars.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] [section: Our Company] Innovation is at our core. We have invested over $76.7 billion in research and development since our inception, yielding inventions that are essential to modern computing. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market and redefined computer graphics. With our introduction of CUDA in 2006, we opened the parallel processing capabilities of our GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI. In 2012, the AlexNet neural network, trained on NVIDIA GPUs, won the ImageNet computer image recognition competition, marking the “Big Bang” moment of AI. We introduced our first Tensor Core GPU in 2017, built from the ground-up for the new era of AI, and our first autonomous driving system-on-chips, or SoC, in 2018. Our acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded our offerings to include networking, enabled our platforms to be data center scale, and led to the introduction of a new processor class – the data processing unit, or DPU. Over the past 5 years, we have built full software stacks that run on top of our GPUs and CUDA to bring AI to the world’s largest industries, including NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving, Clara for healthcare, Omniverse for physical AI applications, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications. In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high-performance computing, or HPC. In 2024, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture – connecting 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs in a data center scale, liquid-cooled design – for real-time trillion-parameter inference and training. In fiscal year 2026, we launched and scaled the NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra platform, optimized for agentic, reasoning, and physical AI. Building on the architectural breakthroughs of Blackwell and leveraging Dynamo inference software, it delivers a significant increase in token throughput and reduction in cost per token compared to the Hopper generation. More recently, in support of market development, we have accelerated the release cadence of our open AI model platforms including NVIDIA Nemotron for agentic AI and Cosmos for physical AI. With a strong engineering culture, we drive fast, yet harmonized, product and technology innovations in all dimensions of computing including silicon, systems, networking, software and algorithms.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202510] During the third quarter of fiscal year 2023, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. During the second quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. During the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. On April 9, 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. We have effectively been foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market will help our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a product that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

3. **全自動駕駛（FSD）訂閱收入提升**，為營收增添額外貢獻【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #78】。

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
因為 NVIDIA 同時提供領先的 GPU 硬體、完整的軟體生態與大量開發者與合作夥伴，使其成為 AI 開發的核心平台，其他公司難以同時具備這樣的全方位能力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

1. **硬體優勢**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備「成千上萬」的運算核心，專為平行工作負載（如神經網路的訓練與推論）設計，讓 AI 演算法能在資料中心規模上快速運算【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。此外，GPU 被認為是「唯一適合 AI」的處理單元，且公司持續在 GPU 架構中加入 AI 專屬功能，以鞏固領先地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。

Our Company

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365 及其 Office 應用程式（如 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook、Teams）中嵌入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，利用 AI 基礎建設與雲端服務，直接把生成式 AI 功能整合進產品裡【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  

- **AI 基礎建設投資**：2026 年三個月（截至 3 月 31 日）期間，Microsoft 365 Copilot 的座位與使用量成長，導致「成本 of revenue」上升 6.8 億美元（$680 百萬），原因是「投資 AI 基礎建設以支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot」【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- **AI 驅動的收入增長**：同一期間，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入成長 19%，主要因為「Microsoft 365 Copilot」提升了每位使用者的收入貢獻【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- **AI 產品平台說明**：Microsoft 在 2026 年的 10‑K 中將 Microsoft 365 Commercial 描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」，結合 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及企業安全與合規功能，並強調未來會持續加入 AI 工具、功能與代理情境（agentic scenarios）【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。  
- **AI 研發與算力投入**：在同一季的營運費用中，Microsoft 表示持續投入「研究與開發算力、AI 人才與資料」以支援整體產品組合的 AI 需求，這些投入同樣支撐了 Copilot 在 Office 應用中的功能擴張【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  

綜合以上，微軟的做法是先在 Azure 與 Microsoft 365 雲端平台上建置 AI 基礎設施與自研模型，然後以 Microsoft 365 Copilot 形式將生成式 AI 功能嵌入各 Office 應用，並透過持續的算力與研發投入，提升每位使用者的產能與收入貢獻。

During the periods presented, we reported our financial performance based on the following segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Our reportable segments are described below. Productivity and Business Processes

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Intelligent Cloud

Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

More Personal Computing

Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology. This segment primarily comprises:

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR/AR 眼鏡與 AI 深度結合，朝打造以沉浸式體驗與 AI 驅動的「元宇宙」新計算平台發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #111】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。

1. **產品路線**：Meta 透過 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置提供社交、遊戲、健身與娛樂等沉浸式體驗，同時加入「passthrough」功能讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間切換【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
2. **AI 眼鏡與 AR**：已推出 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 兩款 AI 眼鏡，內建 Meta AI 對話助理與免手操作功能；2024 年展示的 Orion 原型與 2025 年的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 皆結合了 AI 與鏡片內嵌顯示，並配合可偵測肌電訊號的 Meta Neural Band，讓使用者以神經訊號控制眼鏡【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
3. **AI 投資與願景**：Meta 正大規模投資生成式 AI、超級智慧（superintelligence）等前沿模型，期望透過 AI 強化內容推薦、廣告工具、產品開發效率，並在未來將 AI 融入所有沉浸式介面與服務【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #112】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。  
4. **長期戰略**：公司將「元宇宙」視為下一代社交科技與計算平台，認為它是從 2D 螢幕向全方位沉浸式體驗的演進；因此持續投入虛擬與擴增實境硬體、軟體與內容，並以 AI 為核心驅動力，打造可跨設備、跨平台的生態系統【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #111】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。  
5. **風險與挑戰**：Meta 承認在 Reality Labs（包括 VR/AR 眼鏡）上的投資可能不會成功，若元宇宙的市場接受度低於預期或硬體開發遇阻，將影響財務表現；同時因缺乏消費硬體經驗，其他公司可能在同類產品上取得競爭優勢【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。  

綜合以上，Meta 的方向是把 VR/AR 眼鏡打造成結合 AI 助理與生成式 AI 功能的沉浸式裝置，並以此作為元宇宙平台的核心入口，同時持續投入超級智慧模型以提升內容、廣告與產品創新，儘管仍面臨技術與市場接受度的風險。

records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛之所以被認為在市場上具備差異化優勢，主要是因為它從車輛設計階段即內建可自動駕駛的硬體與軟體平台，採用自家研發的視覺‑AI 系統與客製化推論晶片，並透過 OTA（over‑the‑air）軟體更新持續提升功能，同時已於 2025 年推出 Robotaxi 自動駕駛共乘服務，這些要素共同構成了 Tesla 與其他傳統車廠的主要差異點【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #38】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34】。

- **全車系設計為自動駕駛**：Tesla 表示「每一台今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，且公司相信其 AI 能力能讓其在競爭者之中脫穎而出【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  
- **視覺為主的 AI 架構與自製推論晶片**：Tesla 使用「視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體」來訓練人工神經網路，並由自家設計的推論晶片加速，這與許多仍以雷達或 LiDAR 為主的傳統方案形成對比【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #38】。  
- **OTA 軟體持續升級**：所有已交付的車輛皆可透過 OTA 進行功能與安全性的軟體更新，讓自動駕駛功能得以在現有車輛上不斷演進，這在業界屬於較少見的做法【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  
- **Robotaxi 服務的先行布局**：2025 年 6 月，Tesla 正式啟動 Robotaxi 自動駕駛共乘平台，將自動駕駛技術直接商品化，形成與傳統車廠尚未普及的商業模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34】。

LONDON, June 12 (Reuters) - Hedge funds sold out of the biggest U.S. tech stocks, and some even added ‌bearish positions, according to data from a JPMorgan note late ‌Thursday, just before SpaceX was set to go public on Friday. Shares in the "Magnificent Seven" -- ​a group that includes some of the biggest tech names on Wall Street, namely
Nvidia
,
Apple
, Amazon.com, Alphabet, Meta,
Tesla
, and Microsoft, have all declined since last Friday. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which tracks these ‌stocks closely, declined over 2.4% ⁠since June 5, with some analysts saying investors were clearing their decks in order to prepare for the ⁠debut of Elon Musk's Space X on Friday. SpaceX posted a net loss of $4.94 billion in 2025, but its landmark listing targets a valuation of $1.77 ​trillion ​in a record-setting IPO, which would ​make it the seventh-biggest publicly ‌traded U.S. company by market value.
